prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path layout, finish copy, home layout, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout, sign_in redesign).
Redesigning adoption screens (adoption, redesign) and adding hints to the sign-in screen (sign_in, hint) were helpful and produced winning tests.
Copy revisions on path selection (choose_path, copy) and adding new screens at the finish step (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance.
No clear effect was seen for waiting screen changes (home hint, notification, redesign, wait_info) or finish step tweaks (finish hint, redesign).
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected measured outcomes.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Two-column layout redesign for adoption certificate screen: Redesign the adoption certificate screen using a two-column layout separating certificate details from pet preview visual. (why: Adoption screen redesigns have proven to improve completion rates, and adoption is a key drop-off step with median 89s completion.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive pet naming flow on adoption certificate screen: Introduce an interactive pet name entry input component on the adoption certificate screen before completing adoption. (why: Enhancing adoption interactivity deepens user connection and addresses support reports of pet resets and missing pets.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder sign-in screen after adoption certificate screen: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after adoption certificate completion rather than before friend selection. (why: Completing adoption first creates momentum before asking for sign-in, helping improve the overall 30.5% finish rate.)
3: [sign_in, redesign] List layout redesign for sign-in screen: Rebuild the sign-in screen into a structured list layout clearly detailing authentication options. (why: Sign-in drop-off (82.4% conversion, mean 567s) and 10 support tickets regarding sign-in stalling show layout improvements are needed.)
4: [adoption, hint] Custom pet photo lighting tip on photo upload screen: Add a clear tip on the photo upload screen recommending bright front-facing lighting for custom pet photos. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or rendering incorrectly during adoption photo upload.)
5: [finish, layout] List layout redesign for home intro screen: Rebuild the home intro screen using a list layout to present pet desktop placement status. (why: Finish step drop-off is highest (64.8% completion, 30.5% overall finish), and users reported confusion about controlling their pet.)
6: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud save status badge on sign-in screen: Add a cloud save status badge to the sign-in screen emphasizing pet preservation. (why: Addresses top user concern (8 emails about lost pet data) while motivating completion at sign-in.)
7: [home, wait_info] Desktop overlay loading breakdown on waiting screen: Display explicit setup progress indicators and estimated time remaining during desktop initialization. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s, causing user uncertainty about app loading progress.)
8: [home, notification] Audio ready chime notification toggle on waiting screen: Add an audio ready alert toggle on the waiting screen so users get notified when desktop initialization finishes. (why: High mean waiting duration (2336s) leads users to leave the app unattended while waiting for desktop pet launch.)
